usage: The word 皮 (pei4) is used as a noun to refer to the outer covering or leather of an animal or object.
It can describe materials such as leather used in making goods like shoes, bags, or jackets.
When used, it often directly follows the material or object it describes, like 皮鞋 (pei4 haai4) meaning leather shoes.
It can also mean the skin of fruits or animals in everyday conversation.
In some cases, 皮 can be used metaphorically to describe someone's attitude or behavior, but primarily it refers to a physical material.
